title: Storing planning ahead documents in WillSafe
summary: Use WillSafe, a secure storage facility from NSW Trustee and Guardian, to store your Will, Power of Attorney, and Enduring Guardianship documents.
intro:
NSW Trustee and Guardian's WillSafe is a secure storage facility for your Will, Power of Attorney and Enduring Guardianship documents.

Having a safe place to store these planning ahead documents is important so they can be easily located in the event of your incapacity or death.

If you have not used Trustee and Guardian to draw up your documents, you can still store them in WillSafe for a small fee.

Visit Trustee and Guardian's Will and document storage for more information.
